questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word DELETERIOUS.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Injurious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Deleterious"** means causing harm or damage, often to health or well-being. (हानिकारक)

 
 
• **Example:** Smoking has a deleterious effect on your lungs and overall health.
 
 
 
• **"Injurious"** is a synonym for deleterious, as it also refers to something harmful or likely to cause injury. (नुकसानदायक)
 
 
• **Example:** Prolonged exposure to loud noise can be injurious to your hearing.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of "Deleterious" is "Injurious."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Injurious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Profitable** (लाभदायक): Something that yields financial or other benefits.

 
 
• **Example:** Running an online store can be highly profitable if managed well.
 
 
 
• **Soothing** (सुखदायक): Something that calms or relieves discomfort.
 
 
• **Example:** The soothing sound of rain helped her relax after a stressful day.
 
 
 
• **Beneficial** (फायदेमंद): Something that provides advantages or is useful.
 
 
• **Example:** Regular exercise is beneficial for both physical and mental health.

questions.question: Select the correct option: Neither the editor nor the writers ___ ready to approve the revision.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**were**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is a compound subject ("**Neither the editor nor the writers**").
 
• When a compound subject is connected by "**neither...nor**", the verb agrees with the subject closest to it (in this case, "**writers**").
 
• The noun "**writers**" is plural, so the correct verb is "**were**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Neither the editor nor the writers **were**__ ready to approve the revision."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "was"** is incorrect because "was" is singular, but the subject closest to the verb ("writers") is plural.
 
• **Option 3: "is"** is incorrect because the sentence is in the past tense, not present tense.
 
• **Option 4: "has been"** is incorrect because it does not fit the context of the sentence.

questions.question: Convert into active voice: The parcel will have been handed over by the courier before evening.

options.text: The courier hands over the parcel before evening.
The courier had handed over the parcel before evening.
The courier has handed over the parcel before evening.
The courier will have handed over the parcel before evening.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The parcel will have been handed over by the courier before evening."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the courier" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "will have been handed over" to "will have handed over" (future perfect active).
 
• Ensure the object "the parcel" and time phrase "before evening" remain in their appropriate positions for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The courier will have handed over the parcel before evening."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The courier hands over the parcel before evening." – Incorrect tense (present simple active).
 
• **Option 2:** "The courier had handed over the parcel before evening." – Incorrect tense (past perfect active).
 
• **Option 3:** "The courier has handed over the parcel before evening." – Incorrect tense (present perfect active).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "with theft"** – This is incorrect because "accused with" is not a standard collocation in English.
 
• **Option 2: "by theft"** – This is incorrect because "accused by" changes the meaning and does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 4: "on theft"** – This is incorrect because "accused on" is not a valid grammatical structure.

questions.question: Convert to direct speech: The coach said that the players were improving with every match.

options.text: “The players are improving with every match,” said the coach.
“The players were improving with every match,” the coach said.
“Our players improve with each match,” said the coach.
“The players had improved with each match,” the coach said.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The coach said that the players were improving with every match.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Past continuous (were improving) → Present continuous (are improving)**
 
 
• When converting indirect to direct speech, the tense shifts back to its original form.
 
• “Were improving” becomes “are improving.”
 
 
 
• **Pronouns and word order remain the same**
 
 
• No change in subject because the statement is general.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: “The coach said that…”
 
• Direct: The reported clause comes after the statement → “said the coach.”
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• The direct speech is placed inside quotation marks.
 
• The sentence begins with a capital letter inside quotes.
 
• Comma is used before the reporting clause.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *“The players are improving with every match,” said the coach.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect because it keeps the tense “were improving,” which is indirect, not direct.
 
• **Option 3:** Changes wording and meaning (“Our players” and “improve”), not faithful to the original.
 
• **Option 4:** Changes tense to past perfect (“had improved”), which alters the meaning entirely.

questions.question:
**Rearrange to form a coherent paragraph:**

1. Peer-to-peer networks are the most common type in decentralized systems.

2. Blockchain is essentially a distributed ledger that records transactions securely.

3. This structure ensures openness by validating entries through consensus.

4. Copies of the ledger are shared across multiple computers.

Which is the correct order?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph discusses the basic functioning of blockchain technology.
 
• **Sentence 2 comes first** because it introduces what blockchain is:
 
 
• “Blockchain is essentially a distributed ledger that records transactions securely.”
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 follows** as it describes how copies of the ledger are stored:
 
 
• “Copies of the ledger are shared across multiple computers.”
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 is next** because it explains the network structure supporting decentralization:
 
 
• “Peer-to-peer networks are the most common type in decentralized systems.”
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 is the final statement** as it explains how the system ensures openness:
 
 
• “This structure ensures openness by validating entries through consensus.”
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is **2-4-1-3**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

“Blockchain is essentially a distributed ledger that records transactions securely. Copies of the ledger are shared across multiple computers. Peer-to-peer networks are the most common type in decentralized systems. This structure ensures openness by validating entries through consensus.”

• **Sentence 1 comes first** because it introduces the broad idea of research:
 
 
• "Research is a core driver of scientific and academic development."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2 follows** since it explains what research involves.
 
 
• "It involves systematic inquiry to discover or verify facts."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 is the third** because it elaborates on the types of research.
 
 
• "It may be theoretical for expanding concepts or applied for solving issues."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 is last** as it describes what happens after research is completed.
 
 
• "Results are documented and peer-reviewed to ensure reliability."
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is **1-2-3-4**, which corresponds to **Option 2**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Research is a core driver of scientific and academic development. It involves systematic inquiry to discover or verify facts. It may be theoretical for expanding concepts or applied for solving issues. Results are documented and peer-reviewed to ensure reliability."
